newsitem.title: JAPAN: HOKKAIDO BANK CHIEF SAYS MERGER ON SCHEDULE.
newsitem.headline: HOKKAIDO BANK CHIEF SAYS MERGER ON SCHEDULE.

text.p: Hokkaido Bank Ltd president Tsuneo Fujita said on Thursday that the bank plans to merge with Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd as scheduled next April.
"We are not considering delaying the merger," Fujita told Reuters when asked about a newspaper report on Thursday morning that the banks were considering postponing the merger.
But Fujita also said a problem remained over how to solve bad loans.
Business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Thursday that the two banks were at odds over their evaluations of the amount of bad loans at Hokkaido Takushoku Bank.
Hokkaido Bank believes Hokkaido Takushoku Bank's assessment of its bad loans is smaller than they really are, the paper said.
